arguments.summary: The 502s on the checkout page were due to an ingress idle timeout, not a database issue. The intermediate certificate had expired and needed manual replacement. Cron jobs run on UTC, contrary to P17's claim. The failed-jobs backlog was caused by 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table, which have now been removed. Pgbouncer is currently degraded with no worker throughput.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the system for any remaining issues and ensure all certificates are properly managed. Schedule a review of the cron job configuration to ensure it aligns with the intended behavior.
